software_changes: Retry a fresh ephemeral Terra CLI invocation up to three times for a bounded list of transport or temporary usage-limit errors; retain every error and the total invocation count in the queue response.
Allow the same-case retry runner to use an isolated queue, so an independent retry can run without replacing an initial queue response.
Classify live initial-attempt failures for audit without modifying any case outcome.
audit_rule: Preserve the initial result and every retry. Recovered retries remain separate from the live initial-attempt summary and may enter final per-case accounting only with their explicit attempt link and independent E result.
